findings.description: In work-packages.yaml (lines 150-187), wp-validation-docs is assigned tasks 5.1-5.4 ('Implement tasks 5.1-5.4 and reconcile downstream ownership'), but its scope.write_allow (lines 167-171) only permits modifications under docs/**, openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/**, and openspec/changes/add-sandboxed-harness-execution/**. Task 5.1 in tasks.md (lines 38-39) mandates adding a controlled vendor fixture proving filesystem and egress restrictions, which belongs in skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/tests/ or skills/shared/tests/ and will be rejected by package scope enforcement. Furthermore, verification.steps (lines 180-185) only runs 'openspec validate add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement --strict', omitting execution of the behavioral test fixture (5.1), runtime probe validation (5.2), and test suite / linter runs (5.4).

contracts/dispatch-execution-context.schema.json (lines 7-25) requires schema_version, agent_id, dispatch_mode, isolation, source, and worktree_root. In skills/autopilot/scripts/provider_dispatch.py (lines 39-66), PhaseDispatchPayload omits worktree_root, dispatch_mode, and source, while agent_id and isolation are optional (defaulting to None in callers and tests). While tasks.md task 4.3 mandates 'Add RED/GREEN coverage for autopilot local-provider dispatch using its immutable payload', the plan does not define how provider_dispatch.py constructs a valid DispatchExecutionContext from PhaseDispatchPayload without violating the schema or mutating the caller contract (e.g. how worktree_root is determined without cwd coupling, how phase maps to dispatch_mode, or fallback agent_id/isolation resolution for local Pi provider).

design.md D6 (lines 72-78) and specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md (lines 34-39) require that when the coordinator audit endpoint is unavailable, an unsandboxed fallback requires appending and fsyncing a mode-0600 local outbox before process launch, with later invocations draining older entries. However, the plan fails to specify the canonical outbox location (storing it in worktree_root risks data loss when ephemeral or snapshot worktrees are pruned; storing it in shared locations requires an explicit path under .git/ or a user directory), record serialization (e.g. JSONL), and concurrency control (file locking via fcntl.flock) to prevent file corruption during concurrent review or autopilot dispatches.

In work-packages.yaml lines 82-106, wp-runtime grants write_allow for skills/shared/tests/test_sandbox_profile_integration.py alongside test_sandbox_profile.py to implement tasks 3.1-3.4 (including process-group termination, timeout SIGTERM/SIGKILL, and settings cleanup). However, verification.steps (lines 98-105) only executes test_sandbox_profile.py. Excluding test_sandbox_profile_integration.py from the verification command allows wp-runtime to pass verification without verifying that process lifecycle and integration tests pass.
